q: What is Notch Apple?
k: about overview what is app notchapple dynamic island
a: Notch Apple turns the notch at the top of a MacBook screen (or a small pill on Macs without one, and on Windows) into a command center. Its headline feature is screen-aware AI: press Control-Option-S, drag a box over anything on screen, and solve, explain, translate or summarize it. Around that are 30+ optional tools such as Now Playing, clipboard history, window snapping, a file shelf, a focus timer, F1 and tennis scores and games.

q: Is it really free?
k: free cost price pay money cheap paid
a: Yes. The core app is free. Pro costs $5 and Ultimate costs $15, each paid once, with no subscription and no account. The code is source-available: you can read and build it, but not resell it or unlock the paid features without a key.

q: How much do Pro and Ultimate cost?
k: price pro ultimate upgrade buy purchase cost dollars bitcoin ethereum solana litecoin crypto payment
a: Pro is $5 and Ultimate is $15, both one-time purchases that include every future update. You pay in Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana or Litecoin from the pricing page and your key is made when the payment confirms.

q: What do Pro and Ultimate add?
k: pro ultimate features difference extra premium unlock
a: Pro adds things like the included Notch Apple AI (60 messages a day), live wallpaper, Klick keyboard sounds, a bigger clipboard history and the command palette. Ultimate adds the Convert file converter, Smart Home (Home Assistant), Claude usage, Do It, two activities at once on the notch, more AI messages (200 a day) and more. The pricing page lists everything.

q: How do I get a licence key after paying?
k: key licence license activate activation unlock redeem
a: After the payment confirms, the pricing page shows your key. In the app open Settings, then License, paste the key and press Unlock. A key works on up to 3 computers. If you lose it, the pricing page has a recover option that uses the email you gave.

q: How many computers can one key use?
k: devices macs computers limit three 3 key share
a: Up to 3. You can free a computer by deactivating the key in Settings, then License.

q: Does it work on Windows?
k: windows pc microsoft win10 win11 beta run runs running work works compatible 11 10 support supported
a: Yes, a Windows version is available as a beta. Download the installer from the Download section. Windows may show a SmartScreen warning because the app is not code-signed yet: choose More info, then Run anyway.

q: What do I need to run it?
k: requirements system macos version minimum compatible intel apple silicon m1 m2 m3
a: On Mac: macOS 14 or later, on Apple silicon or Intel. On Windows: Windows 10 or 11.

q: How do I install it on a Mac?
k: install installation download dmg drag applications open first launch unidentified developer gatekeeper
a: Download the DMG, open it and drag Notch Apple into Applications. The app is ad-hoc signed and not notarized, so the first time right-click it and choose Open, then confirm. Or run: xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine "/Applications/Notch Apple.app".

q: Can I install it with Homebrew?
k: homebrew brew cask tap command terminal
a: Yes: brew tap adityajaindxb/notchapples https://github.com/AdityaJainDXB/NotchApples, then brew install --cask notch-apple. Update later with brew upgrade --cask notch-apple.

q: How do I open and close the notch?
k: open close shortcut hotkey keyboard toggle show hide control option
a: Click the notch, press Control-Option-N in any app, or drag a file onto it. Press Esc or click elsewhere to close. Command-E opens and closes it and Command-J hides and shows it. You can also turn on open on hover in Settings.

q: How does screen capture and AI work?
k: capture screenshot ai solve explain translate summarize shortcut control option s drag box screen question
a: Press Control-Option-S in any app, drag a box around a maths problem, an error, a paragraph in another language or a chart, then pick Solve, Explain, Translate, Summarize or Code. The answer streams into the notch and you can keep asking follow-up questions about the same capture.

q: What permissions does it need?
k: permission accessibility screen recording privacy allow macos security settings
a: Screen Recording, asked the first time you capture (macOS applies it after a restart of the app), and Accessibility for window snapping and the volume and brightness gauge. Each permission is used only for the feature that asks for it.

q: Which AI should I use?
k: ai provider gemini ollama groq openai openrouter deepseek anthropic claude free model offline local apple
a: Google Gemini is free and reads images. For complete privacy, install Ollama and run ollama pull gemma3:4b: answers are made on your computer, offline. You can also use Groq, OpenRouter, OpenAI, DeepSeek, Anthropic, or Apple's on-device model. Pro and Ultimate also include Notch Apple AI, which needs no key.

q: What is Notch Apple AI?
k: included hosted ai no key quota messages daily limit pro ultimate 60 200
a: An AI that is included with Pro (60 messages a day) and Ultimate (200 a day) so you can ask without setting up any key. Your own keys still work with no limit.

q: Is my data private? Does it track me?
k: privacy tracking telemetry analytics data collect spying anonymous opt in
a: By default nothing is counted. There is no account and no ads. If you choose to, you can turn on an anonymous user count (a random id, app version, system version and plan, about once a day) and a feedback box in the app's settings. Local AI with Ollama never leaves your computer. The terms page lists exactly what is sent.

q: Does it work on Macs without a notch?
k: notch no notch pill external display older mac
a: Yes. Notch Apple shows a small pill at the top centre of the screen that works exactly the same way.

q: How do updates work?
k: update upgrade new version latest check automatic
a: Notch Apple checks for new releases and shows Update available. Choose Update or Not now, or turn off automatic checks in Settings, then Updates. You can also run brew upgrade --cask notch-apple.

q: Why does window snapping need Accessibility?
k: accessibility window snapping snap
a: Moving other apps' windows is only possible through macOS Accessibility. Notch Apple uses it only to read and set window positions.

q: How do I make it smaller or turn modules off?
k: smaller lighter modules disable turn off tabs hide feature clutter
a: Turn off modules you don't need in Settings, then Modules. Older, smaller builds are also listed in the project README.

q: How do I drag files onto the notch?
k: file shelf drag drop drop zone shelf airdrop share convert
a: Drag a file toward the notch and it opens on the File Shelf, where the drop card takes it. From the shelf you can share it, or with Ultimate convert it to another format. Pin the notch with the pin button to keep it open while you drag.

q: What is the Printer Status tab?
k: printer bambu 3d print status temperature progress filament lan
a: It shows your Bambu 3D printer's status: green printing, yellow paused, blue idle, gray offline, plus progress, time left and nozzle and bed temperatures, with a warning if something runs too hot. There are two ways to connect. On your own network: turn on LAN Mode on the printer (which switches off its cloud features, such as the Bambu Handy app) and add its IP address, access code and serial number in Settings, then Printer Status. Or sign in with your Bambu account in the same place: your password goes only to Bambu and is never saved, the printer keeps its cloud features, and its status then comes through Bambu's servers. Notch Apple is not affiliated with Bambu Lab.

q: Is there a flight simulator?
k: plane flight simulator game fly aircraft airliner fighter helicopter jet cessna
a: Yes, in the Games tab: about 30 aircraft from light planes to airliners, fighters and helicopters, several airfields and islands, weather, ground crew, AI traffic and challenges. W and S are throttle, the arrow keys fly, A and D are rudder, F and V set flaps, G is gear, and H starts a helicopter emergency landing.

q: What are the flight simulator controls?
k: controls keys keyboard fly plane throttle flaps gear brake camera rudder helicopter collective
a: W and S: throttle (collective in a helicopter). Arrow keys: pitch and roll (in a helicopter, up leans forward). A and D: rudder. F and V: flaps down and up. G: gear. Space or B: brakes. X: reverse thrust. C: camera. P: pause. R: restart. 1 to 4 at an apron: refuel, catering, baggage, pushback. H: helicopter emergency landing.

q: How do I use the ground crew in the flight simulator?
k: ground crew pushback refuel catering baggage tug gate apron services
a: Stop on an apron with the throttle closed (airliners start at the gate). Press 1 to refuel, 2 for catering, 3 for baggage and 4 for pushback, where a tug pushes you backward before you start your engines and taxi.

q: What is Klick?
k: klick keyboard sound typing mechanical click
a: A Pro feature that plays mechanical keyboard sounds as you type in any app, with eight sounds and a volume for each.

q: What is cassette mode?
k: cassette music player now playing tape
a: A look for the Now Playing card that shows a cassette tape with the controls beside it. Turn it on or off in Settings.

q: Can I use it on more than one display?
k: multiple displays monitors screens external second
a: Yes. The notch shows on the display you use, and with Ultimate you can choose which tabs show on each display.

q: How do I uninstall it?
k: uninstall remove delete quit stop
a: On Mac, quit the app and drag it from Applications to the Bin. On Windows, use Settings, then Apps, then Installed apps. Your settings are kept in Application Support (Mac) or the app data folder (Windows) and can be deleted too.

q: I found a bug. What should I do?
k: bug crash problem broken issue error glitch report help support
a: Thank you. Open Settings, then Help & Feedback in the app to send a report, or open an issue on GitHub. Say what you were doing, your version and what you saw.

q: How can I suggest a feature?
k: feature request suggest idea feedback wish roadmap
a: Every few weeks the open notch asks for an idea, a problem or praise, and Settings has the same box. The ideas are gathered on a public page.

q: Can I see or change the source code?
k: source code open source github licence license mit build contribute fork
a: The code is source-available on GitHub: you can read it, build it and help improve it, but you can't resell it or unlock the paid features without a key. The exception is the Windows app, which is under the MIT licence. Versions from before 9 October 2026 were MIT.

q: Who makes Notch Apple?
k: who made creator developer team author about
a: Notch Apple is made by Aditya Jain with other high school developers, and is built in the open on GitHub.

q: Does it have a refund policy?
k: refund money back return cancel terms
a: The terms page explains refunds and what is sent when you activate a key.

q: How do I recover a lost key or purchase?
k: lost key recover recovery forgot email resend purchase
a: On the pricing page there is a recover option: enter the email you used and the key is sent again.

q: Is there a racing game, and can I race friends?
k: racing race car cars drift game games friends online room code multiplayer track lap
a: Yes. Open the Games tab and choose Racing (Mac and Windows). Pick a straight sprint, a curved circuit or a mixed track, and a Street GT, Drift King or Muscle car. Drive with the arrows or W A S D, brake and reverse with the down key, and tap Space for the handbrake to drift. Race computer rivals at Easy, Normal or Hard, or press Create room, share the 6-letter code and let friends join with it under Join; the host starts the race for everyone. Your best times stay on your computer.

q: What is the Today tab?
k: today weather calendar events battery date meeting
a: The Today tab shows the date, the current weather, your next calendar events (with a Now badge for a meeting in progress) and your battery at a glance.

q: How does the focus timer work?
k: focus pomodoro timer break session countdown
a: Focus is a Pomodoro timer: 25-minute focus sessions and 5-minute breaks, with a long break every fourth session. While it runs, the countdown shows beside the closed notch, and you get a notification and sound when a session ends. You can change the lengths in Settings → Focus.

q: How does window snapping work?
k: windows snap split screen layout tile drag halves quarters arrange
a: Drag any window up to the notch and a strip of snap zones drops down: halves, quarters, thirds, two-thirds, fill and centre. You can also snap from the Windows tab or with Control-Option plus the arrow keys. Arrange all tiles every window (split screen, 3 columns, grid, main plus stack or cascade), and you can save layouts and bring them back later. It needs the Accessibility permission.

q: What does the clipboard history do?
k: clipboard history copy paste pin search images
a: Everything you copy (text, links, images and files) is saved to a searchable history in the notch. Click an item to copy it again, pin the ones you want to keep, and filter by type. Items that password managers mark as secret are never saved, and the history stays on your Mac.

q: Can it show what music is playing?
k: music now playing spotify apple music lyrics album cover song
a: Yes. Now Playing is free and shows what is playing on your Mac (Apple Music, Spotify, Anghami, browsers, podcasts), with the album cover, a progress bar, previous, play and next buttons and synced lyrics. While music plays, the closed notch shows small controls beside it, and you can scroll with two fingers on it to change the volume or swipe sideways to skip tracks.

q: What are live activities?
k: live activities ears indicators dynamic island closed notch beside
a: Like the iPhone's Dynamic Island, the closed notch shows small indicators on either side: the focus countdown, charging battery and low-battery warnings, unread messages, timers and the stopwatch, the screen recording timer, download and copy progress, Keep Awake, a Join button before Zoom, Meet, Teams or Webex calls, rain alerts, mic or camera use, a followed team's live score and new notifications. Choose which ones show in Settings → Notch Extras.

q: What does the Translator do?
k: translate translator language arabic french spanish hindi mandarin german pronunciation
a: The Translator add-on translates between Arabic, English, French, Spanish, Hindi, Mandarin and German, with a swap button, read-aloud and copy. Non-Latin results also show a pronunciation line made on your Mac. Turn it on in Settings → Modules.

q: What is Messenger?
k: messenger chat message room anonymous wifi encrypted
a: Messenger is a Pro feature for chatting anonymously with people on the same Wi-Fi (found automatically and encrypted between Macs) or in an anonymous room you create or join with a code. Rooms are end-to-end encrypted and nothing is stored anywhere. You get a random handle.

q: What are Voice Notes?
k: voice notes record transcribe summary audio
a: Voice Notes is a Pro feature. Record a note from the notch; it is transcribed on your Mac, and one click turns it into an AI summary with action items using the AI you chose in Settings → AI.

q: What are Screen Time and Focus Blocker?
k: screen time focus blocker apps limits distracting
a: Screen Time (Pro) shows how long you spend in each app, today and over the week, with daily limits that nudge you when you go over. The Focus Blocker hides distracting apps you pick while a Focus session is running. It only counts while you are at your Mac, and everything stays on it.

q: What is Quick Add?
k: quick add calendar reminders natural language event reminder
a: Quick Add (Pro) lets you type naturally, like 'Dentist tomorrow 3pm' or 'remind me to pay rent on the 1st', and it goes into Calendar or Reminders after a preview.

q: Can it lock the notch with Touch ID?
k: biometric lock touch id face unlock password security
a: Yes. Biometric Lock asks for Touch ID, Apple Watch, your password or face unlock (using your Mac's camera) before the notch opens.

q: Is there an iPhone app?
k: iphone companion ios phone app ultimate sideload
a: There is an iPhone companion for the Ultimate tier. It talks to your Mac over Wi-Fi with no server in between: send text and links to the notch, see the Mac's battery and what's playing, control music, start a timer or Keep Awake and open the notch. It is not on the App Store; you install the IPA from the latest release with Sideloadly.

q: Can I control it with Shortcuts or AppleScript?
k: shortcuts applescript automation url scheme notchapple script command
a: Yes. Any notchapple:// link works as a command, Shortcuts has 'Send to Mac notch' and 'Get Mac status' actions, and AppleScript can run commands such as: tell application "Notch Apple" to toggle notch.

q: Can I back up my settings?
k: backup sync icloud export import settings restore account
a: Yes, in Settings → Backup & Sync: sign in with Google to keep your setup in your Notch Apple account, keep it in iCloud Drive, or export a .notchsettings file and import it on another Mac. AI keys, your access code and your Messenger identity are never included in a backup file.

q: Which sports and live scores does it show?
k: sports f1 formula tennis football soccer scores live barcelona nba nfl premier league
a: Sports follows your team (Barcelona by default) with the next match, results and the live score beside the notch. Live shows scores for the Premier League, Champions League, La Liga, MLS, NBA, NFL, MLB and NHL. F1 shows live timing, results and the weekend schedule, and Tennis shows every ATP and WTA match of the week.

q: Are there games in it?
k: games 2048 snake plane reaction racing play
a: Yes. The Games add-on has 2048, Snake and a reaction test, plus a 3D flight game (Plane) and a racing game. Best scores stay on your Mac.

q: Can I make my own plugins?
k: plugin plugins widget develop custom api developer
a: Yes. Plugins let you make your own notch widgets in any language. The README's Plugins section explains how.

q: How do I hide the notch?
k: hide notch menu bar icon disappear shortcut
a: Press Control-Option-O to hide the notch and its menu bar icon, and press it again to bring them back. Everything keeps running while it is hidden.

q: How much CPU and memory does it use?
k: performance cpu memory ram battery light fast resources
a: Measured on Apple silicon with the notch closed, it uses about 0.05% CPU on average and roughly 80 MB of memory. It does not poll while idle.

q: Can it search my files?
k: search files spotlight find apps folders
a: Yes. The Search tab uses Spotlight, so results appear instantly: type to see the best matches, press Return to open and Command-R to reveal in Finder. You can limit it to your home folder or the entire Mac in Settings → File Search.

q: Can it send files with AirDrop?
k: airdrop share send files pairdrop transfer
a: Yes. The Share tab sends files with AirDrop, or with PairDrop between devices on the same Wi-Fi using a 6-digit code. No server is involved. You can also AirDrop everything on the File Shelf.

q: Does it have an audio mixer?
k: audio volume equalizer eq per-app output device
a: Yes. The Audio module lets you pick the output device, set the volume and change per-app volume (0 to 150%) with a 10-band EQ.

q: Can it show AirPods or device batteries?
k: airpods battery devices magic mouse keyboard mic camera iphone
a: Yes. The Devices add-on shows the battery for AirPods (left, right and case), Magic Mouse, Keyboard and Trackpad with a low-battery alert at 15%, which apps are using your microphone or camera, and a one-click mic mute.

q: Can it record my screen?
k: screen recording record video trim
a: Yes. Screen recording has pause and resume, a live timer beside the notch, leaves the notch out of the video and offers a trim step when you stop.

q: Is there a mirror or ring light?
k: mirror camera ring light video call
a: Yes. The Mirror add-on shows a live mirror from your Mac's camera with flip, zoom and a white ring-light frame for dark rooms. The camera only runs while the tab is open and nothing is recorded.

q: What AI actions can I use on a capture?
k: ai modes solve explain summarize translate rewrite code extract text hint
a: After you capture something with Control-Option-S you can pick Solve, Explain, Explain simply, Answer only, Hint, Summarize, Translate, Extract text (done on your Mac), Rewrite, Code or Ask. Answers stream in with readable maths, code blocks with a Copy button and real tables.
